body:
Solace works out of the box for people who don't know engineering practice, on any machine, for Gleam, Rust and JavaScript projects.

- Agents talk to the human at the level the human picks, and put in front of them only the decisions they can make.
- Good practice is built into Solace itself, not this repo's docs: maintainable code as the project grows, no regressions, and agents that push back when a task contradicts something.
- A new user gets from install to a first task without a terminal or reading code.

Everything here has to work in the shipped app, not only on the developer's machine.
title: Approachable Solace
